author: Tom Okafor <tom.okafor@example.com>
message: refactor: drop redundant sort direction from order query
diff:
diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
index 96dd5e0..fb42cd6 100644
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ def list_orders(page: int = 1, size: int = 10, q: str = "") -> list[dict]:
     offset = (page - 1) * size
     with closing(db()) as conn:
         rows = conn.execute(
-            "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE item LIKE ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
+            "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE item LIKE ? ORDER BY id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
             (f"%{q}%", size, offset),
         ).fetchall()
     return [dict(row) for row in rows]
